# retired-presence.txt -- the old friend presence, liveness and delivery names that
# are retired and must not come back (the rule in
# internal/ci/retired_presence_test.go, TestNoRetiredPresenceNameReturns).
#
# The owner, 2026-10-14: "continue to remove the old stuff, so they don't come
# back, or get used when using the tool, or building new code" (v1.3.5). The one
# truth for friend liveness is the nova-hook record and its per-minute challenge,
# only the model proves (nova-tools cmd/nova-hook, docs/SPEC-HOOK.md); the sprint
# reads it (internal/sprint/store/friends.go: "Only nova-hook owns liveness").
# nova-tools holds the same rule over its own tree.
#
# One row per name: `<kind> <name> <what replaced it>`.
#   ident  a Go identifier, matched as a whole word in every .go file
#   text   a command, flag or label, matched in every text file (.go, .md, .sh,
#          .sexp, .txt, .tsv, .yml, .json, .plist, .tla, .cfg), not followed by a
#          letter, digit or underscore
# History is not scanned: CHANGELOG.md, FIXES.md, docs/fixes.sexp, tmp/.

# the coordinator's one-second keepalive loop and its sprint-side record
ident PingEvery nova-hook serve's per-minute challenge
ident RowsEvery nova-hook serve reads the hooked names each pass
ident NewKeepalive the hook record, two misses unhook
ident PeerUp the hook record's proven state
ident PeerDown the hook record's unhooked state
ident cmdFriendHealth the hook record (friend health is deleted)
ident FriendHealth the hook record
text nova-friend serve nova-hook serve

# the coordinator's ping, the wake ping loop and the pong wait
text nova-friend ping nova-hook serve's challenge; nova-friend reach to escalate
text nova-friend wait-pong nova-hook friends --json; nova-friend reach
text friend-wake-ping nova-hook serve, the hook-serve launch agent
text --to-friends nova-hook serve challenges every hooked name
text nova-friend beat the daemon's own beat; liveness is nova-hook's

# the server's old friends rule (presence from beats, pongs and finishes)
ident FriendEvidence the hook record: held, else proven or unhooked
ident FriendDownWhy the hook record's reason
ident FriendBeatBound the hook record; a beat is never liveness
ident FriendPongWindow the hook record
ident FriendProofLive the hook record
ident FriendFinishWindow the hook record; work is not presence
ident FriendDeafAfter nova-hook serve's FRIEND DOWN judgment
ident NFriendDeaf nova-hook serve's FRIEND DOWN judgment
ident FriendSessions the hook record
ident CheckAnswerWithin the hook record
ident LegacyPongGrace the hook record

# the daemon copy's session-check presence, push proof and harness watch
ident StartPresence the hook record
ident SessionCheck the hook record; only the model's nova-hook prove proves a session
ident PushProver the hook record (bus2:push is deleted)
ident PushRenewEvery the hook record
ident HarnessWatch the hook record; a process is never liveness
ident WatchHarness the hook record; a process is never liveness

# the QUEUE.json reconcile: a friend's local queue file once decided her cards' fate (the
# friend lane is a client with no local state, 2026-10-14; nova-tools tla/FriendLaneClient.tla)

ident FriendReconcileOf the server's lane records and its lease (laneGoneUnits)
